description: The escape detector as it is, on the config slices (config_stability at its r_coll 0.005, config_basin at r_coll 0; 32 × 32 each), against check 2's ground truth: pooled precision of the firings by T_h/2 at least the threshold over at least 20 decided firings, and the replay at the register's rule is the detector's own firing on every trajectory. Recall recorded.
